prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A surreal, whimsical scene featuring a Concorde-style supersonic jet soaring through a clear, cloudless blue sky. The jet’s fuselage seamlessly morphs into the elongated, elegant head of a Borzoi dog, complete with soft, flowing fur and expressive eyes, blending hyperrealistic animal features with the sleek, metallic body of the aircraft. The lighting is bright and even, evoking a crisp midday atmosphere, with the smooth gradient of the sky providing a minimalist, uncluttered backdrop. The composition is centered, with the hybrid plane-dog flying from left to right, captured in mid-flight with a slight upward angle that emphasizes motion and aspiration. Above the subject, bold black sans-serif text reads, “Don’t let your dreams be dreams,” adding an inspirational, slightly humorous tone. The overall style is clean and modern, with a touch of absurdist art, combining photorealistic rendering with imaginative, dreamlike elements.
